name: How to Edit PDF Metadata
description: View and change PDF title, author, subject and keywords — no upload needed.

step.name: Open your PDF
step.text: Click 'Choose files' or drag your PDF into the drop zone. Current metadata is displayed immediately.

step.name: Edit or clear the metadata fields
step.text: Update the title, author, subject and keywords fields. Leave fields blank to remove that metadata entirely.

step.name: Download the updated PDF
step.text: Click 'Edit Metadata'. Your PDF downloads with the new metadata embedded — the file content is unchanged.
